title: Payment Integration
description: Payment gateway integration covering order creation, verification, webhooks, refunds, receipts, transaction records, and payment security with Razorpay and Stripe.
learning_outcomes: Integrate payment gateways (Razorpay, Stripe) into applications
Handle webhooks for payment events and status updates
Implement refunds, receipts, and transaction records
Apply PCI DSS compliance and payment security measures
Test payment integrations in sandbox environments
